France vs Spain Live Stream: Kickoff Time, How to Watch & Match Preview

Match Overview

The highly anticipated match between France and Spain will take place on July 14, 2026, at the iconic MetLife Stadium in East Rutherford, New Jersey. This encounter is part of the World Cup, showcasing two of football's most storied nations in a battle for supremacy.

Fixture Details

Why This Match Matters

This match is crucial for both teams as they vie for not only World Cup glory but also national pride. France currently stands with 6 points in the tournament, while Spain sits at 4 points. A victory for France could solidify their position in the knockout stage, while Spain needs at least a draw to remain competitive in the group.

How to Watch

In the US, the match will be available on ESPN+ and fuboTV. UK viewers can tune in to Premier Sports, while Movistar+ will cover the action in Spain. Australian fans can catch the game on beIN Sports, while DAZN will broadcast in Germany and Austria. For those in the Middle East, beIN Sports and TOD will provide coverage. In South Asia, you can watch on FanCode, and Southeast Asia will have options via Vidio and beIN Sports. Please note that availability depends on local rights.
